profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Carterra
profile.summary:
Software development and test engineer. Design, implementation, and testing of application, system, and driver software. Problem solver with excellent debugging skills and a broad exposure to software tools and methodologies. Experience in .NET, C#, Visual Studio, WPF, Angular, SQL, test automation.

Specialties: .net,  c#, visual studio, wpf, wcf, xaml, entity framework, sql, c/c++, asp.net, javascript, angularjs, php, unix/linux, tcp/ip, bash, html5/apache, java

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Write realtime software to control a biosensor device for automated pharmaceutical testing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: On contract at Carterra to write software to control a biosensor device for automated pharmaceutical testing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented a data grid in Workbench with live job status updates that was well-received.

Implemented in-program help for Domo’s Workbench application using C#.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineer for remediating and migrating a very old Laboratory Systems website to new servers. Led a successful major release after two previous leads did not do so.

Mentored an intern on a project to improve a module in the website listed above.

Developed applications for Intermountain's Life Flight team. Developed new features and improve existing features for a clinical information system.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Improve the client UI for a clinical information system at Intermountain Healthcare.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer in Testing
positions.description:
* Performed functional testing for a new search aggregator application for PowerShell located at http://scriptexplorer.microsoft.com using the agile methodology.
* Wrote automated tests in C# using the Visual Studio Unit Test framework and custom XML for new Windows File Server Data Management features.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer in Testing
positions.description:
* Performed functional testing and created automated testing for Balance Financial's web application at http://www.balancefin.com.
* Created functional and automated tests for a Microsoft Word add-in.
* Wrote/executed tests for internal Microsoft applications.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Developed test automation software -- designed software to enhance visibility into adCenter Delivery operations.
*	Wrote an end-to-end system in Silverlight for navigating and displaying key performance indicators.
*	Wrote the UI for an internal asset management system in WPF and C# that manages the lifecycle of thousands of servers.
*	Designed/developed BVT software in C# for Delivery Engine scenarios.
*	Developed data file viewers in C# offering random access to huge, compressed filesets.
*	Created a MS SQL SSIS (integration services) component that extracts and parses CSV data from RAR compressed archives.
*	Diagnosed/identified adCenter Delivery Engine customer issues, defects and performance issues.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer in Testing
positions.description:
Developed/executed test software for the company's flagship product, Network Magic.
*	Performed white-box testing of Network Magic, including API testing, metrics, memory usage analysis and network traffic analysis using C# and C++.
*	Wrote several test tools for Network Magic including a Wireshark plugin for agent traffic, a metrics viewer and a protocol validation tool.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer/Test
positions.description:
Worked at Microsoft developing/executing test software.
*	Wrote the test plan for SQL Server 2005's new Express SKU setup testing and developed and executed automated tests.
*	Wrote automated tests in Perl for validating the Microsoft x64 compiler's exception handling.
*	Development of automated test software in C++ for Windows 2003 Terminal Server.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software development in support of game systems.
*	Implemented a game player as an install-from-the-web ActiveX control using the SDK from a proprietary game engine (in C++/MFC/ActiveX).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: *	Software design of Intel Wireless Series Peripherals and Intel ChatPad using C++.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
* Created and enhanced test automation tools.
* Resolved critical problems in Novell client network protocol and OS interface software.
* Developed network protocol software (in x86 assembly) for Novell's OS2 client interface.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Ported Unix and wrote device drivers (in C) for WICAT's hardware platform.
